payload.title: Measure self.root v0.1 target VPS, token API, ClayCode-only cognition, German translator, self-context and co-resident contention
payload.work_clay: On the Hostinger target VPS/digital-retina, capture the exact non-secret host/resource identity and exercise the real v0.1 server runtime. Bind the accepted/current self.root binary-build and admitted state lineage where available; assert native identity self.root, human surface name Frank, current instance lease/epoch, target embodiment and typed external relations for Andreas, Gabriel, clients and Clay Research DB. Exercise human API flow secure transport -> token auth -> session/client/provenance -> DE_TO_CLAY -> validated ClayCode -> self.root -> ClayCode semantic response + ExpressionState -> CLAY_TO_DE -> German Frank surface, plus the machine-native ClayCode API path. Measure translator round-trip fidelity and latency, especially hard fields: identity, person, negation, quantities, temporal structure, modality, provenance, permission/authority and effect intent. Test translator lesion/substitution, emotional coloring fidelity and semantic-drift rate. Measure self.root SelfContextAssembly hot path against NORMAL_RETRIEVAL with NO_SELF_ROOT, SHUFFLED_IDENTITY_SEED, STALE_ASSEMBLY and PROVENANCE_BROKEN controls; report additional external retrieval roundtrips, UDB query count, context-ready latency, accuracy, staleness and context precision. Exercise governed Research Entity DB bridge as separate authority: authorized query/read and proposal submission only, no identity merge or self-Harness mutation authority. Measure Qwen3.5-4B abliterated Q4_K_M+mmproj fit when current, Retina/ClayCode VisualPercept path, EAP, API, service startup/readiness/recovery and co-resident GitHub runner contention. Compare TARGET_IDLE, API_TRANSLATOR_ONLY, SELF_ROOT_QWEN_ONLY, SELF_ROOT_QWEN_EAP, SELF_CONTEXT_HOTPATH, RUNNER_ONLY, SELF_ROOT_API_PLUS_RUNNER and SELF_ROOT_API_EAP_PLUS_RUNNER with bounded non-destructive workloads.
payload.reason_clay: The newest owner directives define self.root as the native server-binary identity, Frank as human surface name, ClayCode as the sole cognitive semantic language, a state-aware bidirectional German translator as the human boundary, a prebound SelfContextAssembly for self-reference, typed external person/client relations and a governed Clay Research DB bridge. Existing target-host work covered VPS/API/resource truth but not all of these new acceptance dimensions. They are now release-critical and must be measured on the actual target VPS rather than inferred from architecture prose.
payload.completion_clay: Produce a target-VPS baseline receipt binding host/binary/state/model/runtime/API/translator/SelfContextAssembly/UnifiedDB identities and all observed resources. Produce or update FRANK_V0_1_TARGET_VPS_TOKEN_API_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT.json and FRANK_V0_1_CLAYCODE_ONLY_TRANSLATOR_ACCEPTANCE_RECEIPT.json. Report valid/invalid/missing/revoked/rotated token behavior, API concurrency/restart/readiness/provenance, German<->ClayCode semantic/pragmatic fidelity, zero hard-corpus mutations of authority/negation/person/quantity, translator expression fidelity, ClayCode-only cognition lesion proof, self.root hot-path differential metrics, research-bridge authority separation, multimodal VisualPercept path, Qwen/Retina/EAP latencies and co-residency contention. State whether the target VPS can host the complete v0.1 system within a stable resource envelope and which isolation is required. No planned hardware values may substitute for measurements.
controls: human German API vs machine ClayCode API
Frank/self.root API alone vs runner co-residency
payload.executor_policy: Run on the final Hostinger target VPS without destabilizing active services. Use authorized secret injection and persist only non-secret credential references. Core cognition must remain ClayCode-only; German is boundary translation. Do not claim literal zero latency for self-context. Preserve Clay/self.root authority separation. Do not launch paid training or infer missing hardware facts from plans. If the host is insufficient, report the measured blocker and test resource/isolation remedies before proposing migration.
